Japan Agriculture Minister Resigns Over Funding Scandal

Japan's Agriculture Minister Tetsuro Nomura has resigned from his post following allegations of a funding scandal. He is the first minister to step down from the cabinet led by Prime Minister Fumio Kishida. Reports indicate that the resignation is linked to campaign finance irregularities.
